dataset.title: Scientific and Technical Content
dataset.description: We will manage all scientific and technical content generated from this proposal. Our products will include 3 broad types of data. First, we will have data related to each of our proposed experiments. These will include the detailed protocols used for each experiment, the raw data collected from each experiment, and the experimental code used to collect those data. The relevant code will include both the data acquisition code, and the code for the controllers used in the experiment. Together, this information will be sufficient for recreating the circumstances of each data collection session. Our second type of data will be the code and results for all analyses completed on experimental data. Specifically, we store all code necessary to recreate figures, tables, and other results reported in all published manuscripts. The proposed foundational developments will produce substantial simulation code for controller development and testing. These and the outputs relevant to all key findings will also be managed.

distribution.title: Raw and Analyzed Data
distribution.description: Raw data files will be saved in either Matlab or comma-separated value (CSV) format. Code for converting between these formats will also be provided to ensure easy access. The contents of each data file, including the experimental conditions or the analysis procedures used during generation will be documented. All raw data will be de-identified to ensure subject anonymity.

dataset.title: Experimental Videos and Results
dataset.description: Select videos of the experiments will be distributed, with subject faces blurred so as to be unidentifiable. Experimental analyses results will be made available through peer-reviewed journal publications and conference presentations. The code needed to generate all published results will be documented clearly.

distribution.title: Blurred Experimental Videos
distribution.description: Select videos of the experiments will be distributed, with subject faces blurred so as to be unidentifiable.

dataset.title: Software and Code
dataset.description: Software generated under the project will be released under the GNU Public License, and available for free download on the labs’ websites. This includes code for each of our 3 experimental systems. The code and results for all analyses completed on experimental data, including code necessary to recreate figures, tables, and other results reported in all published manuscripts, will be managed.

distribution.title: Software and Code Repository
distribution.description: Software generated under the project will be released under the GNU Public License, and available for free download on the labs’ websites. This includes code for each of our 3 experimental systems.

project.title: Project Title
project.description: The project aims to manage and disseminate data generated by the project, covering all scientific and technical content. Data will be generated at each of our institutional sites. The plan outlines the rights and obligations of all parties. Research records will be archived for a minimum of seven years after final reporting or publication of a project. Data will be made available upon request, after the conclusion of each of study. Access will be free, but the original data collector/creator/principal investigator retains the right to use the data for analysis before making it publicly available. The data will be managed and maintained during the project.
